I don't get it. I don't get the appeal of the story. I don't get the appeal of any of the characters.

Haven't come across a funny moment, no interesting dialogues, no conflict I feel invested in, it's not a light-hearted setting, but also not particularly serious, yet nothing close to being emotional... it's like a mosaic of various bits that don't quite create a picture. What is the theme? Where is the story going? What is the storywriter trying to convey? Not everything needs to be analyzed but there's got to be a point.

Characters have lots of conversation, but nothing stands out as memorable. "Cool" character just act cool, mysterious character is just mysterious, childish character is just childish, kind character is kind. Maybe there is more to it, but I can't force myself to continue with the rest of it. I've read people praising the characters in this game as feeling organic, but I disagree.

It takes effort to read through a chapter, and then I'm exhuasted and I close the game. Try again another day, repeat the same for another chapter and then feel the same. It has been a struggle. Dev tells you to sit back, relax and, enjoy the story, but I cannot imagine myself managing to do so.

Maybe it's something that is wrong about me, but I just don't get it.

Buying this game was my attempt that trying something new, but I suppose it's a niche game in a niche that I was not a part of.
If you are in the same place as me, I would not recommend this game.

Otherwise, the music was rather enjoyable. Art-style reminded me of late 90s to early 2000s otaku fan drawings in some parts, which I thought was interesting (perhaps the creator is within my age group or a bit older). Maybe the world building was interesting at times.
